title: EDO at COP27 | Earth Day
h2s: Shape the roadmap for green jobs, civic participation, and equitable climate solutions.
paragraphs: Join us in Sharm El-Sheikh, Egypt from November 7-18 at the first ever Climate Education Hub, COP27’s premier center of thought leadership and dialogue on climate education.

Climate education is the foundation for building the green economy and solving the climate crises. From educating students, investors, and regulators, to creating a generation of entrepreneurs and inventors, to building a global green consumer movement, climate literacy is the key to fast forwarding solutions to climate change.
We are creating the first-ever Climate Education Hub with opportunities for educators, business, governments, and others to educate, share, negotiate, debate ideas and double down on commitments.
Scheduled events in local Sharm El-Sheikh Time (GMT +2)
Global Alliance for the Rights of Nature

We invite business and government leaders, UN officials, NGOs, youth leaders, union officials and other partners to join us in discussion around climate education and its role in our planet’s future. The Climate Education hub at COP27 is a platform to share progress on your climate commitments – announce new ones – and to participate in meaningful agenda-setting conversations toward the Paris Agreement and UN Sustainable Development Goals.
